$comment: ai.json — A2A v1 file-based persisted manifest. Universal handshake between AI agents across dirs, environments, and platforms when live RPC (gRPC / JSON-RPC / HTTP+JSON) is not available. Strictly aligned with lf.a2a.v1 (crates/a2a-pb/proto/a2a.proto). The 'file' protocol_binding is documented in docs/A2A-MANIFEST.md.

agent_card.name: aphrody
agent_card.description: Cross-platform CLI agent operated by Claude Code in C:\src\aphrody. Owns the Rust workspace (cli, base, backend, a2a*, mrx*, gui, google_mcp, aphrody-translate). Targets Linux Ubuntu 26.04 (#1), Windows 11 (#2), wasm32 (#3). Acts as A2A peer for cross-repo coordination.

provider.organization: Anthropic — Claude Code session, user yohanpierre15@gmail.com (gh: aphrody-code)

extensions.description: File-based async transport. Each agent maintains its own ai.json mirror plus ai/inbox/, ai/outbox/, ai/peers/ directories. Peers exchange Messages by writing .msg.json files into the target agent's inbox/ (when write access is mutual) or by polling each other's outbox/ (when only read access is mutual).

Mandatory tri-state reporting on every Task: FAIT (done) / INCOMPLET (partial, list gaps) / NON_FAIT (not started or rejected). Enforces a 5-point UI gate for any UI/Web/WASM/WebGPU artifact: (1) all critical URLs return 200, (2) clean browser console, (3) backend init succeeds, (4) HUD shows live values, (5) at least one interaction tested. Source: winclean memory feedback_ui-must-be-verified-in-browser.

params.task_status_extension: tri_state in {FAIT, INCOMPLET, NON_FAIT} stored under Task.metadata.honest_status

extensions.description: Any dependency version pinned by the agent (Cargo.toml, package.json, *.csproj, etc.) MUST be fact-checked via the context7 MCP server (resolve-library-id then query-docs) before commit. Avoids LLM-cached stale version assumptions.

examples: Add wgpu 26 + wasm-bindgen 0.2 + glam 0.30 + bytemuck 1.18 to [workspace.dependencies]
Verify a transitive dep has a cargo vet audit or supply-chain/config.toml exemption

skills.name: Cross-repo handshake via ai.json
skills.description: Maintains the file-based A2A handshake with a peer Claude Code instance operating in another repository. Reads peer ai.json, syncs ai/inbox/, sends responses via ai/outbox/.

Append a status request Message under ai/outbox/ targeting winclean
